title: Noun, Pronoun, Adjective, Adverb — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Him is my best friend."
items.reteach: Subjek memakai He: He is my best friend.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "She dances very beautiful."
items.reteach: Cara menari memakai adverb: beautifully.

items.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang tepat tentang sepatu Nina.
items.reteach: Milik Nina = Nina's. Shoes jamak: These are.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "My sister and me go to school by bus."
items.reteach: Subjek memakai I: My sister and I go to school.

items.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang tepat tentang seekor gajah.
items.reteach: Setelah is memakai adjective: big. Elephant tunggal: is.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "The dog wagged it's tail."
items.reteach: Milik anjing: its tail. It's = it is.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "We wrote the answers careful."
items.reteach: Cara menulis memakai adverb: carefully.

items.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang tepat tentang kakak laki-laki Rudi.

visual.text: Rudi's brother is a kind boy.

choices.say: Rudi's brother is a kind boy.

visual.text: Rudi's brother is a boy kind.

choices.say: Rudi's brother is a boy kind.

visual.text: Rudi's brother are a kind boy.

choices.say: Rudi's brother are a kind boy.

visual.text: Rudi brother's is a kind boy.

choices.say: Rudi brother's is a kind boy.

items.reteach: Adjective sebelum noun: a kind boy.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Ali and Sam forgot they books."
items.reteach: Milik mereka sebelum noun: their books.

items.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang tepat tentang dua kucing.

visual.text: The two cats are sleeping peacefully.

choices.say: The two cats are sleeping peacefully.

visual.text: The two cat are sleeping peacefully.

choices.say: The two cat are sleeping peacefully.

visual.text: The two cats are sleeping peaceful.

choices.say: The two cats are sleeping peaceful.

visual.text: The two cats is sleeping peacefully.

choices.say: The two cats is sleeping peacefully.

items.reteach: Two cats (jamak) + are; cara tidur: peacefully.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "Mother gave I a new pencil."
items.reteach: Setelah kata kerja memakai objek: gave me.

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat? "The weather is very well today."
items.reteach: Cuaca bagus memakai adjective: nice atau good.

items.prompt: Read the text about Pak Darto. "He" in the second sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Pak Darto is a farmer in Batu. He grows sweet apples. Every morning, he works happily in his big garden. His apples are famous.

items.reteach: He menggantikan Pak Darto.

items.prompt: Read the text about Pak Darto. Which word in the text is an adverb?

stimulus.text: Pak Darto is a farmer in Batu. He grows sweet apples. Every morning, he works happily in his big garden. His apples are famous.

items.reteach: Happily menjelaskan cara Pak Darto bekerja.

items.prompt: Read the text about Pak Darto. Which adjective describes his garden?

stimulus.text: Pak Darto is a farmer in Batu. He grows sweet apples. Every morning, he works happily in his big garden. His apples are famous.

items.reteach: "His big garden": big menjelaskan garden.

items.prompt: Read the text about Mochi. "Her" in the last sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: My cat, Mochi, is small and fluffy. She sleeps on my bed. When I come home, she runs to me quickly. I love her very much.

items.reteach: Her = Mochi, kucing penulis.

items.prompt: Read the text about Mochi. How does Mochi run to the writer?

stimulus.text: My cat, Mochi, is small and fluffy. She sleeps on my bed. When I come home, she runs to me quickly. I love her very much.

items.reteach: "She runs to me quickly."

items.prompt: Read the text about Mochi. Which words describe Mochi?

stimulus.text: My cat, Mochi, is small and fluffy. She sleeps on my bed. When I come home, she runs to me quickly. I love her very much.

items.reteach: "Mochi is small and fluffy."

items.prompt: Read the LOST notice. "It" refers to …

stimulus.text:
LOST!
A blue water bottle.
It has my name on it: TIKA.
Please return it to Class 4B.

items.reteach: It menggantikan a blue water bottle.

items.prompt: Read the LOST notice. Which word is an adjective?

stimulus.text:
LOST!
A blue water bottle.
It has my name on it: TIKA.
Please return it to Class 4B.

items.reteach: Blue menjelaskan bottle.

items.prompt: Read the LOST notice. Who is the owner of the bottle?

stimulus.text:
LOST!
A blue water bottle.
It has my name on it: TIKA.
Please return it to Class 4B.

items.reteach: Nama di botol: TIKA. Dialah pemiliknya.

items.prompt: Read the text about the twins. How does Ali talk?

stimulus.text: Dodi and Ali are twins. They look the same, but they are different. Dodi talks loudly. Ali talks softly. Their mother can tell them apart easily.

items.reteach: "Ali talks softly."

items.prompt: Read the text about the twins. "Their" refers to …

stimulus.text: Dodi and Ali are twins. They look the same, but they are different. Dodi talks loudly. Ali talks softly. Their mother can tell them apart easily.

items.reteach: Their mother = ibu Dodi dan Ali.

items.prompt: Read the text about the twins. "Tell them apart" means …

stimulus.text: Dodi and Ali are twins. They look the same, but they are different. Dodi talks loudly. Ali talks softly. Their mother can tell them apart easily.

items.reteach: Tell apart = bisa membedakan mana Dodi dan mana Ali.

items.prompt:
Ana: "Is this your pencil?"
Budi: "No, it isn't ___. It's Rina's."
items.reteach: Di akhir kalimat tanpa noun: mine.

items.prompt:
Teacher: "How did you finish the test so well?"
Rio: "I studied ___ last night."
items.reteach: Study hard = belajar keras. Hardly artinya hampir tidak.

items.prompt:
Mom: "Where are your shoes?"
Dika: "I put ___ under the bed."
items.reteach: Shoes jamak, sebagai objek: them.

items.prompt:
Sari: "What does your new bag look like?"
Lina: "___"
items.reteach: Look like = seperti apa bentuknya, dijawab dengan adjective.

items.prompt: Guide at Mount Bromo: "The path is slippery. Please walk ___."
items.reteach: Cara berjalan memakai adverb: carefully.

items.prompt:
Rani: "Who is that man?"
Toni: "___ is my uncle."
items.reteach: Subjek laki-laki: He.

items.prompt:
Seller: "Which bananas do you want?"
Buyer: "I want the ___ ones, please."
items.reteach: The yellow ones = yang kuning.

items.prompt:
Teacher: "Whose drawing is this?"
Students: "It's ___, Ma'am. We drew it together."
items.reteach: Milik kami di akhir kalimat: ours.

items.prompt:
Grandpa: "Can you hear me?"
Nia: "Sorry, Grandpa. Please speak more ___."
items.reteach: Tidak terdengar, jadi minta bicara lebih keras: more loudly.

items.prompt:
Dina: "How is your new teacher?"
Eka: "She is very ___. She always smiles."
items.reteach: Friendly = ramah (adjective).

items.prompt:
Andi: "Tina and Tono, are these your crayons?"
Tina: "Yes, they are ___."
items.reteach: Tina menjawab untuk dirinya dan Tono: ours (milik kami).

items.prompt:
Coach: "The race starts now!"
Fans: "Run ___, Joko!"
items.reteach: Run fast = lari cepat. Fast sudah adverb; tidak ada fastly.

items.prompt: Arrange: dog / big / a / has / Rudi
items.reteach: Adjective (big) sebelum noun (dog).

items.prompt: Ganti "Mrs. Sri" dengan kata ganti: "Mrs. Sri cooks rendang."
items.reteach: Mrs. Sri perempuan, sebagai subjek: She.

items.prompt: Change the adjective into an adverb: "He is a slow walker." → "He walks ___."
items.reteach: Slow + ly = slowly.

items.prompt: Arrange: sings / sister / my / sweetly
items.reteach: Subjek + kata kerja + adverb.

items.prompt: Ganti "Bayu and Dimas" dengan kata ganti: "I play with Bayu and Dimas."
items.reteach: Bayu dan Dimas sebagai objek: them.

items.prompt: Combine: "The kite is red. The kite is big."

visual.text: The kite is big and red.

choices.say: The kite is big and red.

visual.text: The kite is big red and.

choices.say: The kite is big red and.

visual.text: The big and red is kite.

choices.say: The big and red is kite.

visual.text: The kite are big and red.

choices.say: The kite are big and red.

items.reteach: Gabungkan dua adjective dengan and.

items.prompt: Arrange: very / is / Malang / cool / in / weather / the

visual.text: The weather in Malang is very cool.

choices.say: The weather in Malang is very cool.

visual.text: The weather in Malang very is cool.

choices.say: The weather in Malang very is cool.

visual.text: Malang the weather is cool very in.

choices.say: Malang the weather is cool very in.

visual.text: The weather Malang in is very cool.

choices.say: The weather Malang in is very cool.

items.reteach: The weather in Malang (subjek) + is + very cool.

items.prompt: Change into the possessive form: "The bag belongs to Tono."
items.reteach: Milik Tono: Tono's bag.

items.prompt: Ganti "Siti" dengan kata ganti: "Give the ball to Siti."
items.reteach: Setelah to memakai objek: her.

items.prompt: Arrange: quietly / the / reads / girl / clever
items.reteach: Adjective (clever) sebelum girl, adverb (quietly) setelah reads.

items.prompt: Change "a happy smile" into "She smiles ___."
items.reteach: Menjelaskan cara tersenyum: happily.

items.prompt: Change into plural: "He is a good student."
items.reteach: He is menjadi They are, student menjadi students.

items.prompt: Riddle: I take the place of a noun. "He", "she", and "it" are my examples. What am I?
items.reteach: Kata ganti = pronoun.

items.prompt: Which word does not belong: slowly, softly, friendly, quickly?
items.reteach: Friendly adalah adjective; yang lain adverb.

items.prompt: Analogy: quick → quickly, happy → …
items.reteach: Y diubah menjadi i, lalu + ly: happily.

items.prompt: Analogy: I → my, they → …
items.reteach: I menjadi my, they menjadi their (milik mereka).

items.prompt: How many nouns are in this sentence? "The girl puts a book and a pen on the desk."
items.reteach: Noun: girl, book, pen, desk = 4.

items.prompt: How many adjectives are in this sentence? "The small black cat drinks warm milk."
items.reteach: Adjective: small, black, warm = 3.

items.prompt: Code: N = noun, A = adjective. Which pattern matches "green leaf"?
items.reteach: Green = adjective, leaf = noun: A N.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am an adjective with five letters. I am the opposite of "heavy". What am I?
items.reteach: Heavy (berat) lawannya light (ringan).

items.prompt: Which pronoun can fill both blanks? "___ is raining. ___ is Monday today."
items.reteach: Untuk cuaca dan hari kita memakai It.

items.prompt: Put the adjectives in order from smallest to biggest.
items.reteach: Tiny (sangat kecil), small, big, huge (sangat besar).

items.prompt: Which sentence has an adverb?
items.reteach: Sweetly menjelaskan cara burung bernyanyi.

items.prompt: Analogy: man → he, woman → she, book → …
items.reteach: Benda tunggal diganti it.
